_comment: Settings and known lists for the Web browser tests job (TC-2120). The job REQUIRES this file: a missing, unreadable or invalid one (minTests not a positive integer, projects empty) fails the job rather than loosening the checks. The job fails on any failure that is NOT a listed known red, on a skipped test that is not in knownSkipped, and on an incomplete report: no tests, fewer than minTests, a project in `projects` with none, a spec file with none, stats that disagree with the tests, or a Playwright exit status other than 0 (1, test failures fully explained by known reds, is the only other one accepted). minTests: raise it when specs are added (it is a floor that catches a spec file that stops loading; the suite had 164 tests when it was set). knownReds: a listed test that fails is printed as a known red; when it passes the job prints 'known red now passes: delete it from the list'. Entry format: { project, file, title (as in the report), reason, line }. project, file, title and reason must be non-empty text (the reason is the diagnosis: an entry without one fails the job); line is optional and informational, a positive integer when present. Add an entry only with a diagnosis, not as a skip, and delete it when the spec is fixed. The same rules apply to knownSkipped. A test that failed and passed on its retry is a flake: Playwright reports it and the job passes, so there is no list for it.
